meta.name: comment-checker
meta.description: Use when Codex needs to understand or respond to automatic comment-checker feedback emitted after an edit-like PostToolUse hook.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 理解并回应代码审查的自动反馈
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在编辑代码后处理自动审查反馈。
copy.tagline_en: Understand and respond to automatic code review feedback
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to handle automatic review feedback after editing code.

howto.what: 装上后，在代码编辑操作成功后会自动运行评论检查；若发现注释问题，会给出警告并暂停操作，要求先修复或解释被标记的注释，然后才继续。
howto.when: 在成功执行代码编辑类操作（如 apply_patch、write、edit 等）后触发；也用于需要理解或回应评论检查反馈时。

say.text: 请修复代码里被检查器标记的注释
say.note: 会暂停并等修复后再继续。

say.text: 解释一下这个注释警告的原因
按评论检查器的要求调整注释

howto.what_en: After successful edit operations, runs comment checks; if issues found, blocks with warning and asks to fix or explain flagged comments before continuing.
howto.when_en: Triggers after successful edit-like operations such as apply_patch, write, edit, multi_edit, etc.

say_en.text: Please fix the comment flagged by the checker.
say_en.note: It will pause and continue after fixing.

say_en.text: Explain why this comment warning occurred.
Adjust the comment as required by the checker.
